1.title: Andhra History: Firsts and State Formation

mcqs.question: The first linguistic state of Andhra was formed in which month and year?
mcqs.explanation: The first linguistic state of Andhra was formed in April 1953 after separation from Madras.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Tanguturi Prakasam was the first Chief Minister of Andhra State in 1953.
Chandulal Madhavlal Trivedi was the first Governor of Andhra Pradesh.
Bezawada Gopala Reddy was the last Chief Minister of Andhra State.
Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was the first Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh in 1956.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is the third one. Chandulal Madhavlal Trivedi was the first Governor of Andhra Pradesh, while the first Governor of Andhra Pradesh was Chandulal Madhavlal Trivedi; the altered detail is the office description in relation to the other listed state offices.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Andhra became the first linguistic state in 1953.
Reason (R): Andhra State was formed in April 1953 after separation from Madras.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The formation of Andhra State in April 1953 after separation from Madras established it as the first linguistic state.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
(a) First Chief Minister of Andhra State
(b) First Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh
(c) First Governor of Andhra Pradesh
(d) First Speaker of Andhra State

List-II
(i) Chandulal Madhavlal Trivedi
(ii) Tanguturi Prakasam
(iii) Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
(iv) Nallapati Venkatramaiah
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: Tanguturi Prakasam—first Chief Minister of Andhra State; Neelam Sanjiva Reddy—first Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh; Chandulal Madhavlal Trivedi—first Governor of Andhra Pradesh; Nallapati Venkatramaiah—first Speaker of Andhra State.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Rajasekhara Charitram was the first novel in Telugu.
II. Satya Doota was the first Telugu journal.
III. Andhra Prakasika was the first political journal in Andhra.
IV. The Bible was the first book printed in Telugu.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct. The notes identify Rajasekhara Charitram, Satya Doota, Andhra Prakasika and the Bible as the respective first Telugu novel, journal, political journal and printed book.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The first Andhra Mahasabha or Conference was held at Bapatla on 26 May 1913.
Statement B: Govinda Rao Nanal was the first President of the Hyderabad State Congress.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The first Andhra Mahasabha or Conference was held at Bapatla on 26 May 1913, and Govinda Rao Nanal was the first President of the Hyderabad State Congress.

mcqs.question:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. First widow remarriage in Andhra
B. First Telugu session of the Indian National Congress
C. Andhra Pradesh Legislature became bicameral for the first time
D. First World Telugu Conference
mcqs.explanation: The correct order is A, B, C, D: widow remarriage in 1881, the Telugu session of the INC in 1891, bicameral legislature in 1958, and the World Telugu Conference in 1975.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Satavahanas were the first historical ruling dynasty of the Deccan.
II. Harihara-I was the first ruler of Vijayanagara.
III. Devaraya-I was the first Vijayanagara monarch to enlist Muslims in the army.
IV. The first Muslim invasion of Warangal took place in 1303.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct according to the historical firsts listed: Satavahanas, Harihara-I, Devaraya-I and the 1303 invasion of Warangal.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
(a) First Dutch factory in Andhra
(b) First factory by the English in Andhra
(c) First introduction of Ryotwari
(d) First Indian State to sign the Subsidiary Alliance

List-II
(i) Baramahals
(ii) Hyderabad
(iii) Masulipatnam or Machilipatnam
(iv) Machilipatnam, 1611
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: Dutch factory—Masulipatnam or Machilipatnam; English factory—Machilipatnam in 1611; Ryotwari—Baramahals; first Indian State to sign the Subsidiary Alliance—Hyderabad.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) First Speaker of Andhra State
(b) First Speaker of Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly
(c) First Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra State
(d) First Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh

List-II
(i) K.V. Rangareddy
(ii) Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao
(iii) Nallapati Venkatramaiah
(iv) Dr. N. Sanjeeva Reddy
mcqs.explanation: Nallapati Venkatramaiah was the first Speaker of Andhra State, while Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao was the first Speaker of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly. Dr. N. Sanjeeva Reddy and K.V. Rangareddy were the first Deputy Chief Ministers of Andhra State and Andhra Pradesh respectively.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Bezawada Gopala Reddy was the last Chief Minister of Andhra State.
Statement B: The Andhra Pradesh Legislature became bicameral for the first time in 1958.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are correct. Bezawada Gopala Reddy was the last Chief Minister of Andhra State, and the Andhra Pradesh Legislature became bicameral for the first time in 1958.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) First President of Andhra Congress Circle
(b) First President of Hyderabad State Congress
(c) First Secretary of Socialist Party of Andhra unit
(d) First President of Andhra Socialist Party

List-II
(i) N.G. Ranga
(ii) M. Annapurnayya
(iii) Nyapati Subba Rao
(iv) Govinda Rao Nanal
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Nyapati Subba Rao–Andhra Congress Circle, Govinda Rao Nanal–Hyderabad State Congress, M. Annapurnayya–Secretary of the Socialist Party of Andhra unit, and N.G. Ranga–Andhra Socialist Party.

mcqs.question: Who was the first Telugu President of the Indian National Congress?
mcqs.explanation: P. Anandacharyulu was the first Telugu President of the Indian National Congress. He presided over the 1891 session at Nagpur.

mcqs.question: Who was the first Muslim leader from Hyderabad to join the Indian National Congress?
mcqs.explanation: Mulla Abdul Qayyum was the first Muslim leader from Hyderabad to join the Indian National Congress.

mcqs.question: Who was the first elected Chief Minister of Hyderabad State?
mcqs.explanation: B. Ramakrishna Rao was the first elected Chief Minister of Hyderabad State.

mcqs.question: Which case was the first criminal case in the Vandemataram Movement?
mcqs.explanation: The Kakinada Riot Case was the first criminal case in the Vandemataram Movement.

mcqs.question: Which police station was attacked first by Alluri Sitarama Raju?
mcqs.explanation: Chintapalli was the first police station attacked by Alluri Sitarama Raju.

mcqs.question: Where did the Forest Satyagraha first start?
mcqs.explanation: The Forest Satyagraha first started in Palnadu in the Guntur area.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Bible was the first book printed in Telugu.
Reason (R): Rajasekhara Charitram was the first novel in Telugu.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but the first Telugu novel does not explain which was the first book printed in Telugu. The Bible was the first book printed in Telugu, while Rajasekhara Charitram was the first Telugu novel.

mcqs.question: What was the first Telugu library in Hyderabad?
mcqs.explanation: Sri Nilayam was the first Telugu library in Hyderabad.

mcqs.question: Who compiled the first English-Telugu dictionary?
mcqs.explanation: C.P. Brown compiled the first English-Telugu dictionary.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) First Kisan School
(b) First World Telugu Conference
(c) First Jnanpith in Telugu
(d) First Telugu cinema director

List-II
(i) 1975
(ii) H.M. Reddy
(iii) Nidubrolu
(iv) Viswanatha Satyanarayana
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Nidubrolu–First Kisan School, 1975–First World Telugu Conference, Viswanatha Satyanarayana–First Jnanpith in Telugu, and H.M. Reddy–First Telugu cinema director.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) First ruler of Vijayanagara
(b) First Vijayanagara monarch to enlist Muslims in the army
(c) First Chalukya-Chola emperor
(d) First poet to translate the Mahabharata into Telugu

List-II
(i) Nannaya
(ii) Harihara-I
(iii) Devaraya-I
(iv) Kulottunga-I
mcqs.explanation: Harihara-I was the first ruler of Vijayanagara, Devaraya-I was the first Vijayanagara monarch to enlist Muslims in the army, Kulottunga-I was the first Chalukya-Chola emperor, and Nannaya was the first poet to translate the Mahabharata into Telugu.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) First Dutch factory in Andhra
(b) First English factory in Andhra
(c) First introduction of Ryotwari
(d) First Indian State to sign the Subsidiary Alliance

List-II
(i) Baramahals
(ii) Hyderabad
(iii) Masulipatnam/Machilipatnam
(iv) Machilipatnam, 1611
mcqs.explanation: The first Dutch factory in Andhra was at Masulipatnam/Machilipatnam. The first English factory was at Machilipatnam in 1611, Ryotwari was first introduced in the Baramahals, and Hyderabad was the first Indian State to sign the Subsidiary Alliance.

mcqs.question: Where was the first All-India Congress session held in Andhra?
mcqs.explanation: The first All-India Congress session held in Andhra took place at Vijayawada.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following pairs are correctly matched?
1. First Telugu journal — Satya Doota
2. First political journal in Andhra — Andhra Prakasika
3. First Telugu library in Hyderabad — Sri Nilayam
4. First English-Telugu dictionary — C.P. Brown
mcqs.explanation: All four pairs are correct: Satya Doota, Andhra Prakasika, Sri Nilayam and C.P. Brown correspond respectively to the first Telugu journal, first political journal in Andhra, first Telugu library in Hyderabad and first English-Telugu dictionary.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The first widow remarriage in Andhra took place on 11 December 1881 at Rajahmundry.
Statement B: Veeresalingam was associated with the first widow remarriage in Andhra and wrote Rajasekhara Charitram.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The first widow remarriage in Andhra took place at Rajahmundry on 11 December 1881, associated with Veeresalingam, who also wrote Rajasekhara Charitram.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Vallabhaneni Sitamahalakshmi was the first woman arrested in the Salt Satyagraha.
Statement B: Nyapati Subba Rao was the first lawyer in Andhra to boycott British courts.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Vallabhaneni Sitamahalakshmi is identified as the first woman arrested in the Salt Satyagraha, while Nyapati Subba Rao was the first lawyer in Andhra to boycott British courts.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) First inscription in Telugu
(b) Inscription in which the Kakatiyas were mentioned for the first time
(c) First Muslim invasion on Warangal
(d) First sultanate invasion on the Kakatiyas

List-II
(i) Alauddin Khilji
(ii) Kalamalla inscription
(iii) 1303
(iv) Magallu inscription
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: (a) Kalamalla inscription, (b) Magallu inscription, (c) 1303, and (d) Alauddin Khilji.

mcqs.question: Who was the first poet to translate the Mahabharata into Telugu?
mcqs.explanation: Nannaya was the first poet to translate the Mahabharata into Telugu.

mcqs.question: In which year did the Andhra Pradesh Legislature become bicameral for the first time?
mcqs.explanation: The Andhra Pradesh Legislature became bicameral for the first time in 1958.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The first Andhra Mahasabha was regarded as the first Telugu session.
Reason (R): It demanded a separate university.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: The first Andhra Mahasabha was the first Telugu session, and it demanded a separate university. The demand for a university does not explain why the session was regarded as the first Telugu session.

mcqs.question: Who presided over the first Andhra Mahasabha or Andhra Conference?
mcqs.explanation: B. N. Sharma presided over the first Andhra Mahasabha or Andhra Conference.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Satya Doota
(b) Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam
(c) Komarraju Lakshmana Rao
(d) First Kisan School

List-II
(i) Associated with Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam
(ii) Nidubrolu
(iii) Bellary
(iv) Established in 1901
mcqs.explanation: Satya Doota was published at Bellary; Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam was established in 1901; Komarraju Lakshmana Rao was associated with it; and the first Kisan School was at Nidubrolu.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The first Rayalaseema Mahasabha is associated with 28 January 1934/1936 and Madras.
Statement B: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah granted permission for the English factory at Machilipatnam.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The first Rayalaseema Mahasabha is associated with 28 January 1934/1936 and Madras. Permission for the English factory at Machilipatnam was granted by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah.

2.title: Last Rulers and Andhra State CM

mcqs.question: Who was the last Chief Minister of Andhra State?
mcqs.explanation: Bezawada Gopala Reddy was the last Chief Minister of Andhra State.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Bezawada Gopala Reddy served as Chief Minister of Andhra State from 1955 until 1956.
Reason (R): Andhra State merged to form Andhra Pradesh in 1956.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The merger of Andhra State to form Andhra Pradesh in 1956 explains the end of Bezawada Gopala Reddy’s tenure as its Chief Minister.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Vijayaditya VII was the last king of the Eastern Chalukyas.
Vasanta Raju was the last Reddy king.
Errana was the last king of the Eastern Chalukyas.
Pulomavi III was regarded as the last ruler of the Satavahanas according to the Puranas.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Errana was the last king of the Eastern Chalukyas. The correct name is Vijayaditya VII; Errana was the last poet of the Kavitrayam.

mcqs.question: According to the Puranas, who was the last ruler of the Satavahanas?
mcqs.explanation: According to the Puranas, Pulomavi III was the last ruler of the Satavahanas.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Vasanta Raju was the last Reddy king.
Statement B: Errana was the last poet of the Kavitrayam and served as the court poet of Prolaya Vema Reddy.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Vasanta Raju was the last Reddy king, while Errana was the last poet of the Kavitrayam and the court poet of Prolaya Vema Reddy.

mcqs.question: Which inscription is associated with the last Satavahana king, Pulumavi IV?
mcqs.explanation: The Myakadoni inscription is associated with Pulumavi IV, identified in the notes as the last Satavahana king.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I (Inscription)
a. Nasik
b. Motupalli
c. Draksharama
d. Tripuranthakam

List-II (Key association)
i. Rudra Deva's success stories
ii. Military achievements of Gautamiputra Satakarni
iii. Ganapatideva
iv. Victorious achievements of Amba Deva

Choose the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: Nasik records Gautamiputra Satakarni's military achievements; Motupalli is associated with Ganapatideva; Draksharama records Rudra Deva's successes; and Tripuranthakam records Amba Deva's victories.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: The Pithapuram inscription mentions Kolleru lake.
The Kalamalla inscription is identified as the first inscription in Sanskrit.
The Pedavegi inscription of Nandi Varma-II records a grant of land to Vishnu.
The Bhattiprolu inscription mentions the Nigama-sabha of the Satavahanas.
mcqs.explanation: The altered detail is the language: the Kalamalla inscription is identified in the notes as the first inscription in Telugu, not Sanskrit.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Allahabad Pillar inscription mentions Hastivarma.
Reason (R): The Allahabad Pillar inscription was issued by Samudragupta.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are given in the notes: the inscription was issued by Samudragupta and mentions Hastivarma. However, its issuer does not explain why Hastivarma is mentioned.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Brihatpalayanas were feudatories of the Ikshvakus.
Statement B: The Kondamudi Copper Edict is the only inscription about the Brihatpalayanas.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The notes state both that the Brihatpalayanas were feudatories of the Ikshvakus and that the Kondamudi Copper Edict is the only inscription about them.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Porumamilla inscription gives 12 rules for tank construction.
II. The Santhana Sagaram inscription is related to a tank by Surambika.
III. The Mutnuri inscription records the completion of steps to Pathala Ganga in 1346.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are directly supported by the notes: Porumamilla gives 12 tank-construction rules, Santhana Sagaram is linked with Surambika's tank, and Mutnuri records the 1346 completion of the steps to Pathala Ganga.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I (Inscription)
a. Nagarjunakonda
b. Manchikallu
c. Chejerla
d. Eluru

List-II (Key fact)
i. Mentions 'Munyada', a political employee
ii. Wars between Ikshvakus and Anandagotrikas
iii. Ikshvaku dynasty
aiv. Simhavarma; found near Vijayapuri and similar to Nagarjunakonda

Choose the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: Nagarjunakonda is linked with the Ikshvaku dynasty; Manchikallu is associated with Simhavarma; Chejerla records wars between the Ikshvakus and Anandagotrikas; and Eluru mentions Munyada.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following inscription–fact pairs are correctly matched?

1. Nasik — Ushavadatta invested 2000 Karshapanas in a weaver's guild.
2. Motupalli — Ganapatideva.
3. Allahabad Pillar — Hastivarma.
4. Myakadoni — Pulumavi IV.
mcqs.explanation: All four pairs are correct according to the notes: Nasik records Ushavadatta's investment, Motupalli is linked with Ganapatideva, Allahabad mentions Hastivarma, and Myakadoni is associated with Pulumavi IV.

mcqs.question: Who located the Satavahanas in Bellary?
mcqs.explanation: V.V. Sukthankar located the Satavahanas in Bellary.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Junnar
(b) Pithapuram
(c) Magallu
(d) Kodavali

List-II
(i) Danarnava
(ii) Chanda Satakarni
(iii) Prithvisvara of Velanadu
(iv) Chanda Satakarni inscription
mcqs.explanation: Junnar is associated with Chanda Satakarni; Pithapuram with Prithvisvara; Magallu with Danarnava; and Kodavali with the Chanda Satakarni inscription.

mcqs.question: What is a key feature of the Alluru inscription?
options: It gives 12 rules for tank construction.
It mentions the first Telugu inscription.
It records the steps to Pathala Ganga.
It records multiple gifts to different sections and institutions.
mcqs.explanation: The Alluru inscription records multiple gifts to different sections and institutions.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Marturu inscription refers to Mangalagiri as Mangalapura.
Statement B: The Vipparla inscription was issued by Jayasimha Vallabha.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are correct. Marturu mentions Mangalagiri as Mangalapura, and Vipparla was issued by Jayasimha Vallabha.

mcqs.question: Which inscription mentions a musical instrument?
mcqs.explanation: The Dharmasagar or Dharmasagaram inscription mentions a musical instrument.

mcqs.question: The Jalakaranda inscription is related to which person?
mcqs.explanation: The Jalakaranda inscription is related to Prince Bhaskara Bhavadura.

mcqs.question: Which inscription is identified as the first inscription in Telugu?
mcqs.explanation: The Kalamalla inscription is identified as the first inscription in Telugu.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following pairs are correctly matched?

1. Bhattiprolu — Mentions the ‘Nigama-sabha’ of the Satavahanas
2. Erragudi — Ashoka asked teachers to inculcate Dharma in students
3. Pedavegi — First to mention Vishnu temples in Andhra
4. Bodhisri — Evidence of Buddhism patronage under the Ikshvakus
mcqs.explanation: All four pairs are correctly matched according to the inscriptions’ recorded features.

mcqs.question: According to the Musunuri inscription, how did Pratapa Rudra die?
options: He died while constructing a tank.
He died in a battle at Vijayapuri.
He died jumping into the Narmada.
mcqs.explanation: The Musunuri inscription states that Pratapa Rudra died by jumping into the Narmada.

mcqs.question: Prolaya Vema Reddy served in whose court, according to the Anitalli inscription?
mcqs.explanation: The Anitalli inscription records that Prolaya Vema Reddy served in Kapaya Nayaka’s court.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Prolaya Vema Reddy ruled till 1353.
Statement B: The steps to Pathala Ganga at Srisailam were completed in 1346.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The relevant records mention Prolaya Vema Reddy’s rule till 1353 and completion of the steps in 1346.

mcqs.question: Who issued the Kolleru inscription?
mcqs.explanation: The Kolleru inscription was issued by Nandi Varma-II.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Eluru inscription mentions ‘Munyada’.
Reason (R): The Eluru inscription was issued by Nandi Varma-II.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: The assertion is true because Eluru mentions ‘Munyada’, a political employee. The reason is false: the Eluru inscription was issued by Devavarma; Nandi Varma-II issued the Kolleru inscription.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Chejerla
(b) Manchikallu
(c) Bodhisri
(d) Kolleru

List-II
(i) Issued by Nandi Varma-II
(ii) Important evidence of Buddhism patronage under Ikshvakus
(iii) Wars between Ikshvakus and Anandagotrikas
(iv) Found near Vijayapuri and similar to Nagarjunakonda
mcqs.explanation: Chejerla records wars between the Ikshvakus and Anandagotrikas; Manchikallu was found near Vijayapuri; Bodhisri is evidence of Ikshvaku Buddhism patronage; and Kolleru was issued by Nandi Varma-II.

mcqs.question: The Kodavali inscription is associated with which ruler?
mcqs.explanation: The Kodavali inscription is identified as the inscription of Chanda Satakarni.

mcqs.question: In the inscriptional context, what does the term ‘Gulmika’ denote?
mcqs.explanation: The notes state that ‘Gulmika’ means a feudatory chief.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Kazipet inscription records the accession of Durga Nripathi to the throne.
Reason (R): The inscription is associated with Betha Raju II/Durgaraja.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true according to the notes. The association with Betha Raju II/Durgaraja identifies the inscription, but it does not explain the recorded accession of Durga Nripathi.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Manyamapura
(b) Mani Kesavara
(c) Pedavegi
(d) Chejerla

List-II
(i) Wars between Ikshvakus and Anandagotrikas
(ii) Capital shifted from Addanki to Kondaveedu
(iii) Grant of land to Vishnu and first mention of Vishnu temples in Andhra
(iv) Prolaya Vema Reddy ruled till 1353
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Manyamapura–capital shifted from Addanki to Kondaveedu; Mani Kesavara–Prolaya Vema Reddy ruled till 1353; Pedavegi–grant to Vishnu and first mention of Vishnu temples in Andhra; Chejerla–wars between Ikshvakus and Anandagotrikas.

mcqs.question: Which inscription is noted as the first to mention Vishnu temples in Andhra?

(ii) Sub-Collector of Rajahmundry who opened Anglo-vernacular schools
(iii) Advisor to the king in judiciary

mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Pradvivaka–advisor to the king in judiciary, Srinatha–educational officer, G.N. Taylor–Sub-Collector of Rajahmundry, and V. Veeranna–helper in Godavari Barrage construction.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Satavahana administration:

I. The Mantri Parishad helped the king in administration.
II. The Nigama Sabha or Nigama Subhas looked after the administration of cities and towns.
III. The Gramani had jurisdiction over five or ten villages.
IV. The Gaaha Pati was a representative of farmers.
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are directly supported by the notes: the Mantri Parishad assisted the king, the Nigama Sabha administered cities and towns, the Gramani covered five or ten villages, and the Gaaha Pati represented farmers.

mcqs.question: In the Satavahana administration, who were the military officers administering Aharas away from the capital?
mcqs.explanation: Mahasenadhipathulu were military officers who administered Aharas away from the capital.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I

(b) Rajaamatyulu
(c) Mahaamatyulu

List-II
(i) Special Officers
(ii) Advisors
(iii) Employees consulted for important decisions

mcqs.explanation: Visvamaatyulu were consulted for important decisions, Rajaamatyulu were advisors, and Mahaamatyulu were Special Officers.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Satavahana Gramani is incorrect?
options: The Gramani administered Aharas away from the capital.
The Gramani had jurisdiction over five or ten villages.
The Gramani's jurisdiction could extend over ten villages.
The Gramani was associated with village-level administration.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the Gramani administered Aharas away from the capital. A Gramani had jurisdiction over five or ten villages; Mahasenadhipathulu administered Aharas away from the capital.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Gaaha Pati was the representative of the farmers.
Statement B: The Kakatiya Bahathara Viyogaduipathi held supreme authority over all departments.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Gaaha Pati was the Karshaka Pratinidhi, or representative of farmers. The Bahathara Viyogaduipathi held supreme authority over all departments.

mcqs.question: What was the collective name of all administration departments under the Kakatiyas?
mcqs.explanation: Bahathara Viyog was the collective name of all administration departments.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Kakatiya Ayagarlu enjoyed land without any cess or tax.
Reason (R): The number of Ayagarlu was twelve.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Ayagarlu enjoyed land without any cess or tax, and their number was twelve; however, their number does not explain their tax-free landholding.

mcqs.question: Which Kakatiya official levied taxes based on the assessment given by the Karanam?
mcqs.explanation: The Pedakapu or Reddy was the official who levied taxes based on the assessment given by the Karanam.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The number of Kakatiya village officers was twelve.
Statement B: The Kakatiya village officers enjoyed land without any cess or tax.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The number of Kakatiya village officers was twelve. Enjoying land without any cess or tax was a feature of the Ayagarlu, not the village officers generally.

mcqs.question: In which year was the Office of Collector introduced in the North Sarkar region?
mcqs.explanation: The Office of Collector was introduced in the North Sarkar region in 1802.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Satavahana Nigama Sabha or Nigama Subhas looked after the administration of cities and towns.
Statement B: The Satavahana Gramani had jurisdiction over five or ten villages.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The Nigama Sabha administered cities and towns, while the Gramani had jurisdiction over five or ten villages. Hence, both statements are true.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Satavahana Amatyas administered the Aharas.
Reason (R): Satavahana Mahasenadhipathulu were military officers who administered Aharas away from the capital.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but the role of the Mahasenadhipathulu as military officers administering Aharas away from the capital does not explain the general administrative role of the Amatyas.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: G.N. Taylor was the Sub-Collector of Rajahmundry.
V. Veeranna helped Sir Arthur Cotton in the construction of the Godavari Barrage.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that G.N. Taylor opened Telugu-medium schools. The stated detail is that he opened Anglo-vernacular schools.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Pradvivaka
(b) Srinatha

(d) Bahathara Viyogaduipathi

mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Pradvivaka–advisor to the king in judiciary, Srinatha–educational officer, Pedakapu or Reddy–tax-levying official, and Bahathara Viyogaduipathi–supreme authority over all departments.

mcqs.question: Which Satavahana body helped the king in administration?
mcqs.explanation: The Satavahana Mantri Parishad helped the king in administration.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following entries in the administrative system have a numerical specification?

1. Gramani — jurisdiction over five or ten villages
2. Ayagarlu — number twelve
3. Kakatiya Village Officers — number twelve
4. Nigama Sabha — administration of cities and towns
mcqs.explanation: The Gramani, Ayagarlu and Kakatiya Village Officers have numerical specifications. The Nigama Sabha is described by its function, not by a number; therefore, only three entries qualify.

11.title: Telugu Language, Scripts and Literary Milestones

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Satavahana common people's language
(b) Salankayana language from Sanskrit onwards
(c) Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi official language
(d) Language of Sangam literature

List-II
(i) Tamil
(ii) Desi Bhaasha
(iii) Telugu
(iv) Sanskrit
mcqs.explanation: Satavahana common people's language was Desi Bhaasha, Salankayana used Sanskrit onwards, Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi had Telugu as their official language, and Sangam literature was in Tamil.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Prakrit was the official language of the Satavahanas.
Three of the eight Salankayana inscriptions were in Prakrit.
Telugu became the official language of Andhra Pradesh from 1956.
Early Ikshvaku inscriptions were in Prakrit.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is the year 1956. Telugu became the official language of Andhra Pradesh from 1966.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): All Satavahana inscriptions were written in Prakrit using the Brahmi script.
Reason (R): Prakrit was the official language of the Satavahanas.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: Satavahana inscriptions were in Prakrit and Brahmi script, and Prakrit was the Satavahana official language. However, the official-language status of Prakrit does not explain the use of the Brahmi script.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Kalamalla inscription was the first Telugu inscription.
II. Rajasekhara Charitram was the first Telugu novel.
III. Satya Doota was the first Telugu journal and was associated with Bellary.
IV. C. P. Brown was associated with the first English-Telugu dictionary.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct. The notes identify Kalamalla as the first Telugu inscription, Rajasekhara Charitram as the first Telugu novel, Satya Doota of Bellary as the first Telugu journal, and C. P. Brown with the first English-Telugu dictionary.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The first World Telugu Conference was held in 1975.
Statement B: Sri Krishnadevaraya Bhasha Nilayam in Hyderabad was established in 1901 as the first Telugu library.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The first World Telugu Conference was held in 1975, while Sri Krishnadevaraya Bhasha Nilayam in Hyderabad dates to 1901 and is identified as the first Telugu library.

mcqs.question: The early inscriptions of the Ikshvakus were written in which language?
mcqs.explanation: The early inscriptions of the Ikshvakus were written in Prakrit.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding Salankayana inscriptions is incorrect?
options: Salankayana inscriptions show the use of Sanskrit from a later stage.
Prakrit was used in a part of the Salankayana inscriptional record.
All eight Salankayana inscriptions were in Prakrit.
Three of the eight Salankayana inscriptions were in Prakrit.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that all eight inscriptions were in Prakrit. The stated figure is three out of eight.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Desi Bhaasha was the language of the common people during the Satavahana period.
Reason (R): Desi Bhaasha belonged to the Dravidian family.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but belonging to the Dravidian family does not explain why Desi Bhaasha was the language of common people.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Sanskrit was used by the Salankayanas from a later stage onwards.
Statement B: Telugu was the official language of the Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are correct: Sanskrit came into use among the Salankayanas from later onwards, while Telugu was the official language of the Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi.

mcqs.keyword: Known as – Other Name – Ancient Name – Modern Name
mcqs.question: Who called Telugu the “Italian of the East”?
mcqs.explanation: The British called Telugu the “Italian of the East”.

mcqs.question: Telugu became the official language of Andhra Pradesh in which year?
mcqs.explanation: Telugu has been the official language of Andhra Pradesh from 1966.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are correct according to the language-related historical record.

mcqs.question:

options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, and the association of Pali with early Buddhist literature explains why most early Buddhist literature was written in Pali.

mcqs.question: The Telugu script developed from which source?
mcqs.explanation: Brahmi was the source of the Telugu script.

mcqs.question: What was the purpose of the first World Telugu Conference?
options: To introduce Telugu as the official language in 1947
To promote Sanskrit education in the Madras Presidency
To encourage Telugu language, literature and culture
To establish the first Telugu library in Hyderabad
mcqs.explanation: The World Telugu Conference was first held to encourage Telugu language, literature and culture.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the first Telugu library:

III. It was founded by Komarraju Lakshmana Rao.
IV. It was established to develop Telugu language and literature in Telangana.

mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct. The first Telugu library was established in Hyderabad in 1901 by Komarraju Lakshmana Rao for developing Telugu language and literature in Telangana.

How many of the following details are associated with the first Telugu library?

2. 1901

mcqs.explanation: All four details are associated with the first Telugu library.

mcqs.question: Who was associated with the first English-Telugu dictionary?
mcqs.explanation: C. P. Brown was associated with the first English-Telugu dictionary.

mcqs.question: Who wrote the first Telugu novel, Rajasekhara Charitram?
mcqs.explanation: Rajasekhara Charitram, identified as the first Telugu novel, was written by Veeresalingam.

mcqs.explanation: Five of the eight Salankayana inscriptions were written in Sanskrit.

mcqs.question: Who was the queen of Bobbili associated with the Battle of Bobbili (1757)?
mcqs.explanation: Mallamma Devi was the queen of Bobbili associated with the Battle of Bobbili in 1757.

mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Bobbili–1757, Chandurthi–1758, Padmanabham–1794 and Raichur–1520.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): After the Battle of Tallikota, the capital of Vijayanagara shifted to Penugonda.
Reason (R): The Battle of Tallikota was fought between the Adil Shahis of Bijapur and Ramaraya.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are given in the notes. However, identifying the combatants does not itself explain the subsequent shift of the capital to Penugonda.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: The Battle of Padmanabham was fought in 1795.
The Battle of Raichur was fought in 1520 and was the greatest battle fought by Sri Krishnadevaraya.
The Battle of Tallikota was fought in 1565 between the Adil Shahis of Bijapur and Ramaraya.
The Battle of Padmanabham was between East India Company troops under Colonel Prendergast and Pusapati Chinna Vijayarama Raju II of Vizianagaram.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is the year 1795. The Battle of Padmanabham was fought in 1794.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: In the Battle of Palnadu, Nagamma and Nalagama Raju were responsible, and Kakati Rudra Deva helped.
Statement B: The Muthukur Battle was fought between the Kakatiya forces of Ganapatideva, allied with Manmasiddhi II, and the Pandyan king Jatavarman Sundara Pandya I.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are supported by the notes: they give the responsibility and assistance in the Palnadu Battle and the participants in the Muthukur Battle.

mcqs.question: The Battle of Padmanabham was fought in which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Battle of Padmanabham, also referred to as the Battle of Padmanabha, was fought in 1794.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Battle of Padmanabham is incorrect?
options: Colonel Prendergast led the East India Company troops.
Pusapati Chinna Vijayarama Raju II belonged to Vizianagaram.
It was fought between the Kakatiya forces and the Pandyan king.
It was fought between the East India Company troops and Pusapati Chinna Vijayarama Raju II.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement alters the parties involved. The Kakatiya forces and the Pandyan king fought in the Muthukur Battle, not in the Battle of Padmanabham.

mcqs.question:

List-I

mcqs.question: The Battle of Raichur was fought in which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Battle of Raichur was fought in 1520.

mcqs.question: Which battle is described as the greatest battle fought by Sri Krishnadevaraya?
mcqs.explanation: The Battle of Raichur is described as the greatest battle fought by Sri Krishnadevaraya.

mcqs.question:

A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but the parties involved do not explain why the battle occurred in the year 1263.

mcqs.question: Who led the Kakatiya forces in the Muthukur Battle?
mcqs.explanation: The Kakatiya forces in the Muthukur Battle were led by Ganapatideva.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Ganapatideva's forces were allied with Manmasiddhi II in the Muthukur Battle.

options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Ganapatideva's Kakatiya forces were allied with Manmasiddhi II. The Pandyan king was Jatavarman Sundara Pandya I.

mcqs.question: Who was the Pandyan king involved in the Muthukur Battle?
mcqs.explanation: The Pandyan king involved in the Muthukur Battle was Jatavarman Sundara Pandya I.

mcqs.question:

III. The conflict took place at Panjerighat.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The notes identify the first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju with the Rampa Rebellion, in 1922, at Panjerighat.

mcqs.question: The first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju was associated with which rebellion?
mcqs.explanation: The notes identify the first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju with the Rampa Rebellion.

mcqs.question: In which year did the first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju take place?
mcqs.explanation: The first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju took place in 1922.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju is incorrect?
options: It involved the followers of Alluri Sitarama Raju.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is the year. The war was fought in 1922; 1794 is the year of the Battle of Padmanabham.

mcqs.question:

B. Battle of Raichur

D. First face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju
mcqs.explanation: The correct sequence is Muthukur Battle (1263), Battle of Raichur (1520), Battle of Padmanabham (1794), and the first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju (1922).

mcqs.question:

mcqs.explanation: All four year-event pairings are correct: Padmanabham–1794, Raichur–1520, Muthukur–1263, and the first face-to-face war involving Alluri Sitarama Raju–1922.

mcqs.question:

options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: the English army defeated the French army in the Battle of Chandurthi, and the battle was associated with the Northern Circars. However, the association with the Northern Circars does not explain the English victory.

mcqs.question: Who took French help in the Battle of Bobbili?
mcqs.explanation: Vijayaramaraju took French help in the Battle of Bobbili.

mcqs.question: The Battle of Palnadu was fought in which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Battle of Palnadu was fought in 1182. The other years correspond to the Muthukur Battle, the Battle of Raichur and the Battle of Tallikota, respectively.

mcqs.question: Moturpha was which of the following?

mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: Third Andhra Mahasabha–1915, first Rayalaseema Mahasabha session–1934, first Nizam Mahasabha Andhra session–1930, and Jatiya Mahasabha Andhra–1944.

mcqs.question: Who organized the first session of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha?
mcqs.explanation: The first session of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha was organized by K. Subrahmanyam.

mcqs.question: Who presided over the second session of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha?
mcqs.explanation: K. Subrahmanyam presided over the second session of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha at Kadapa.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Andhra Jana Sangham was formed in 1921 under Madapati Hanumantha Rao.
Statement B: It was formally restructured and renamed as the Andhra Mahasabha.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The Andhra Jana Sangham was formed in 1921 under Madapati Hanumantha Rao and was later restructured and renamed as the Andhra Mahasabha.

mcqs.question: Who presided over the first session of the Nizam Mahasabha Andhra?
mcqs.explanation: Suravaram Pratapa Reddy presided over the first Nizam Mahasabha Andhra session at Jogipet in 1930.

mcqs.question: Who founded the Jatiya Mahasabha Andhra?
options: Madapati Hanumantha Rao and B.N. Sharma
Ravi Narayana Reddy and K. Subrahmanyam
Suravaram Pratapa Reddy and Burgula Ramakrishna Rao
Konda Venkatappayya and Nemali Pattabhirama Rao
mcqs.explanation: The Jatiya Mahasabha Andhra was founded by Suravaram Pratapa Reddy and Burgula Ramakrishna Rao.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Communist faction took control of the main Andhra Mahasabha at the historic 11th Bhongir Session in 1944.
Reason (R): The session was presided over by the communist leader Ravi Narayana Reddy.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but Ravi Narayana Reddy’s presiding over the session does not itself explain the Communist faction’s takeover.

mcqs.question: Who strongly supported Vishalandhra at the second session of the Vishalandhra Mahasabha?
mcqs.explanation: Swamy Ramananda Tirtha strongly supported Vishalandhra at the second session of the Vishalandhra Mahasabha.

mcqs.question: On which date was the first session of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha held?
mcqs.explanation: The first session of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha was held on 28 January 1934.

mcqs.question: At which place was the Andhra Mahasabha (Hyderabad State) formed at a conference?
mcqs.explanation: The Andhra Mahasabha (Hyderabad State) was formed at a conference held at Medak. It emerged after the Andhra Jana Sangham was formally restructured and renamed.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) President of the inaugural Andhra Mahasabha
(b) B.N. Sharma's other name
(c) President of the 1936 Andhra Mahasabha Convention
(d) President of the first Rayalaseema Mahasabha session

List-II
(i) Vijayanagar Gajapati
(ii) Konda Venkatappayya
(iii) Nemali Pattabhirama Rao
(iv) Bayya Narasimheswara Rao
mcqs.explanation: Konda Venkatappayya presided over the inaugural Andhra Mahasabha. B.N. Sharma was also known as Bayya Narasimheswara Rao, Vijayanagar Gajapati presided over the 1936 Convention, and Nemali Pattabhirama Rao presided over the first Rayalaseema Mahasabha session.

mcqs.question: During 1941–1946, the Andhra Mahasabha was based at which place?
mcqs.explanation: The Andhra Mahasabha was based at Visakhapatnam during 1941–1946.

mcqs.question: What was the demand of the Third Andhra Mahasabha held in 1915?
options: Creation of a separate Andhra Province (Andhra Rashtram) with the mother tongue as the medium of instruction in secondary schools
Bridging trust deficits between Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema leaders
Creation of a separate Telugu university
Opposition to the formation of a separate Andhra state
mcqs.explanation: The Third Andhra Mahasabha demanded the creation of a separate Andhra Province, or Andhra Rashtram, with the mother tongue as the medium of instruction in secondary schools.

mcqs.question: Who designed and constructed the Dowleswaram Anicut in 1852?
mcqs.explanation: The notes state that Sir Arthur Cotton designed and constructed the Dowleswaram Anicut in 1852.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: The Bhimeshwara Temple on the Godavari banks was built by Chalukya Bhima I.
The Ramappa Tank Temple at Palampet was built by Recharla Rudra.
The Draksharama Bhimeswara and Kumararama Bhimeswara temples were built by Chalukya Bhima II.
The Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavala were dedicated to Lord Shiva by Prola Raju-II.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is the ruler's name: the Draksharama Bhimeswara and Kumararama Bhimeswara temples were built by Chalukya Bhima I, not Chalukya Bhima II.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Ayaka pillars at the Amaravati Stupa represent the five key events in Buddha's life.
Reason (R): The Amaravati Stupa is associated with the Satavahanas.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are given in the notes. However, the association of the Amaravati Stupa with the Satavahanas does not explain what the Ayaka pillars represent.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
 a. Fort St. George
 b. Rajahmundry
 c. Dowleswaram Anicut
 d. Siro Mandapam

List-II
 i. Anavema Reddy
 ii. Sir Arthur Cotton
 iii. English East India Company
 iv. Ammaraja Vishnuvardhana
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: Fort St. George–English East India Company; Rajahmundry–Ammaraja Vishnuvardhana; Dowleswaram Anicut–Sir Arthur Cotton; Siro Mandapam–Anavema Reddy.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Ramappa Tank Temple is located at Palampet and is associated with Recharla Rudra.
II. The Pakala Tank was built across the Munneru river basin in Warangal by Rudra, an army officer of Ganapathi Deva.
III. Prolaya Vema Reddy built the stepped stone pathways to the Pathala Ganga descent at Srisailam and the shrine at Ahobilam.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct according to the notes: they identify the builders or associated persons and locations of the Ramappa Tank Temple, Pakala Tank and the Sopanamargas.

mcqs.question: Who fought 108 fierce battles over 12 years against the Rashtrakutas and their Gangavadi allies?
mcqs.explanation: Vijayaditya II fought 108 fierce battles over 12 years against the Rashtrakutas under Govinda III and Amoghavarsha I and their Gangavadi allies.

mcqs.question: Which ruler built the dual twin temples of Draksharama Bhimeswara and Kumararama Bhimeswara at Samalkota?
mcqs.explanation: Chalukya Bhima I built the dual twin temples of Draksharama Bhimeswara and Kumararama Bhimeswara at Samalkota.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
 a. Bhimeshwara Temple
 b. Thousand-Pillar Temple
 c. Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavala
 d. Jaina Basthi

List-II
 i. Mailamma
 ii. Chalukya Bhima I
 iii. Prola Raju-II
 iv. Rudra Deva
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Bhimeshwara Temple–Chalukya Bhima I, Thousand-Pillar Temple–Rudra Deva, Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavala–Prola Raju-II, and Jaina Basthi–Mailamma.

mcqs.question: The Thousand-Pillar Temple is associated with which place?
mcqs.explanation: The Thousand-Pillar Temple was built by Rudra Deva at Anumakonda.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The chaityams associated with the queens of the Satavahanas were meant for Buddhist monks.
Statement B: The chaityams were dedicated to Lord Shiva.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The chaityams associated with the queens of the Satavahanas were for Buddhist monks. The notes do not state that they were dedicated to Lord Shiva.

mcqs.question: For whom were the chaityams associated with the queens of the Satavahanas intended?
mcqs.explanation: The chaityams associated with the queens of the Satavahanas were intended for Buddhist monks.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavala were dedicated to Lord Shiva.
Statement B: Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavala were associated with Prola Raju-II.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavala were associated with Prola Raju-II and were dedicated to Lord Shiva.

mcqs.question: Who built Kesari Samudram?
mcqs.explanation: Kesari Samudram was built by Betha Raju-II.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Prolaya Vema Reddy built stepped stone pathways to important sacred shrines.
Reason (R): These pathways were constructed to facilitate pilgrimage to Ahobilam and the perilous Pathala Ganga descent at the Srisailam Mallikarjuna temple.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Prolaya Vema Reddy built the Sopanamargas to make pilgrimage to Ahobilam and the Pathala Ganga descent at Srisailam easier.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The stepped stone pathways were called Sopanamargas.
II. One of the destinations served by these pathways was Ahobilam.
III. The pathways were built for pilgrimage to the Srisailam Mallikarjuna temple's Pathala Ganga descent.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The Sopanamargas led pilgrims towards Ahobilam and the Pathala Ganga descent at the Srisailam Mallikarjuna temple.

mcqs.question: The Jaina Basthi at Kadalyam was associated with which place?
mcqs.explanation: The Jaina Basthi, also identified as Kadalyam, was associated with Anamakonda.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Thousand-Pillar Temple is associated with Rudra Deva.
Reason (R): The temple was built at Anumakonda.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but the location at Anumakonda does not explain why the temple is associated with Rudra Deva.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Chalukya Bhima I is associated with the Bhimeshwara Temple.
II. Betha Raju-II is associated with Kesari Samudram.
III. Prolaya Vema Reddy built the Sopanamargas.
IV. Mailamma built the Thousand-Pillar Temple.
mcqs.explanation: Statements I, II and III are correct. Mailamma was associated with the Jaina Basthi, while the Thousand-Pillar Temple was built by Rudra Deva.

mcqs.question: The name ‘Kesari Samudram’ was derived from which royal title of Betha Raju-II?
mcqs.explanation: Kesari Samudram was named after the royal title of Betha Raju-II, namely Vikrama Kesari.

mcqs.question: The Siro Mandapam at Srisailam was intended for Shaivite devotees who:
options: Offered their own limbs or heads to Lord Mallikarjuna
mcqs.explanation: The Siro Mandapam was meant for Shaivite devotees who offered their own limbs or heads (Siro-karthanam) to Lord Mallikarjuna.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Vijayaditya II built 108 Saiva temples.
Reason (R): Narendraeswara was built by Vijayaditya II.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Vijayaditya II built 108 Saiva temples, and Narendraeswara was also built by him; however, the construction of Narendraeswara does not explain the number of Saiva temples built.

mcqs.question: Rajahmundry was established on the banks of which river?
mcqs.explanation: Rajahmundry was established on the banks of the Godavari as the Eastern Chalukyan capital.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Betha Raju II built Setti Samudram.
Statement B: Betha Raju II built Kete Samudram.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Setti Samudram and Kete Samudram were built by Betha Raju II.

mcqs.question: Who was the wife of Bethanamathya?
mcqs.explanation: Mailamma was the wife of Bethanamathya.

19.title: Institutions, Education and Libraries in Andhra

mcqs.question: Who established the Madrasa-e-Aliya in 1873?
mcqs.explanation: Madrasa-e-Aliya was established by Salar Jung I in 1873 at Hyderabad.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission was established on 1 November 1956 under Article 315.
The Deccan Education Society was established in Pune in 1884 by Agarkar, Tilak, Chiplunkar and Namjoshi.
Noble College and High School was established at Machilipatnam in 1843.
Osmania University was the first Indian university to use Urdu as the regional vernacular medium for higher education.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is ‘Urdu’ in the second statement. The notes identify Osmania University as the first Indian university with a regional vernacular, Urdu, as the higher-education medium; therefore the statement itself is actually correct. Hence no option is incorrect as drafted.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Andhra University was inaugurated from Bezwada to Waltair.
Reason (R): Andhra University was associated with the Andhra University Act of 1925.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: Andhra University was associated with the 1925 Act and was inaugurated from Bezwada to Waltair. However, the Act does not explain the location sequence of its inauguration.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I

(b) Noble College / High School
(c) Deccan Education Society
(d) Andhra Jatheeya Kalasala

List-II
(i) 1843
(ii) 1866
(iii) 1884
(iv) 1910
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are American Baptist Mission–1866, Noble College / High School–1843, Deccan Education Society–1884, and Andhra Jatheeya Kalasala–1910.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The High Court of Andhra State was located at Guntur, and Koka Subba Rao was its first Chief Justice.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission was established on 1 November 1956 under Article 315.

IV. Chapa Koodu / Dasa Samaj was associated with Brahma Nayudu in Palnadu during c.1170–1182 CE.
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are supported by the notes: they identify the establishment details of the APPSC, Sri Venkateswara University, MIM, and Chapa Koodu / Dasa Samaj.

mcqs.question: The Madrasa-e-Aliya, established in 1873 at Hyderabad, primarily served the sons of which groups?
mcqs.explanation: Madrasa-e-Aliya was established at Hyderabad in 1873 for the sons of nobility and Paigah families.

mcqs.question: Who founded the Vivekavardhini Patasala/Sangham?
mcqs.explanation: Kandukuri Veeresalingam founded the Vivekavardhini Patasala/Sangham in 1874 at Rajahmundry.

mcqs.question: The Vignana Chandrika Mandali was established in which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Vignana Chandrika Mandali was established in 1901 at Hyderabad and promoted popular science, history and political literature in Telugu.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam was established in 1906.
Statement B: It was the first non-government public Telugu library in Telangana/Hyderabad.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam was established in 1906 and was the first non-government public Telugu library in Telangana/Hyderabad.

mcqs.question: What was the significance of the Dutch Factory established at Machilipatnam in 1605?
options: It was the first Telugu public library in Telangana
It was the first university using Urdu as a higher-education medium
It was the first permanent Dutch trading factory in India
It was the first nationalist vocational school in Andhra
mcqs.explanation: The Dutch Factory at Machilipatnam was established by VOC in 1605 and was the first permanent Dutch trading factory in India.

mcqs.question: The American Baptist Mission at Ongole was popularly known by which name?
mcqs.explanation: The American Baptist Mission, founded by Lyman Jewett and John E. Clough in 1866 at Ongole, was known as the “Lone Star” Mission.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The AP Sahitya Academy was established by the Government of Andhra Pradesh in 1957.
II. It dealt with Telugu literature, manuscripts and lexicons.
III. It was established as a nationalist vocational school at Machilipatnam.
mcqs.explanation: Statements I and II are correct. The AP Sahitya Academy was established by the Government of Andhra Pradesh in 1957 and dealt with Telugu literature, manuscripts and lexicons; statement III describes Andhra Jatheeya Kalasala.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Osmania University was the first Indian university with a regional vernacular as the medium of higher education.
Reason (R): Urdu was used as the medium of higher education at Osmania University.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, and the use of Urdu explains why Osmania University is identified as the first Indian university with a regional vernacular as the higher-education medium.

mcqs.question: Which institution was formed in 1887 through the merger of a school and Madrasa-i-Aliya?
mcqs.explanation: Nizam College was established in 1887 through the merger of a school and Madrasa-i-Aliya.

mcqs.question: Andhra Samvardhani Granthalayam, an early Telugu library, was established in which place and year?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Samvardhani Granthalayam was an early Telugu library established at Secunderabad in 1905.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Chapa Koodu or Dasa Samaj is associated with the Palnadu region.
Reason (R): It promoted inter-caste dining.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, and inter-caste dining is the key feature associated with Chapa Koodu/Dasa Samaj. It was linked with Brahma Nayudu in Palnadu during approximately 1170–1182 CE.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I

(d) Andhra Jatheeya Kalasala

(ii) VOC

(iv) Hanumanta Rao, Krishna Rao and Pattabhi
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: Dutch Factory–VOC; American Baptist Mission–Lyman Jewett and John E. Clough; AP Sahitya Academy–Government of Andhra Pradesh; Andhra Jatheeya Kalasala–Hanumanta Rao, Krishna Rao and Pattabhi.

mcqs.question: Sri Venkateswara University was established in which year at which place?
mcqs.explanation: Sri Venkateswara University was established in 1954 at Tirupati, with T. Prakasam as its founder.

mcqs.question: Who founded the MIM in 1927?
mcqs.explanation: The MIM was founded in 1927 by Mahmood Nawaz Khan Qiledar. The notes also mention its later Bahadur Yar Jung and Kasim Razvi/Razakar phase.

mcqs.question: The Andhra State and Hyderabad State were merged in which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Andhra State and Hyderabad State were merged in 1956.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the Vivekavardhini Patasala/Sangham:
I. It promoted rationalism.
II. It promoted female literacy.
III. It opposed the caste system.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcqs.explanation: The Vivekavardhini Patasala/Sangham promoted rationalism and female literacy and opposed the caste system.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: K.V. Lakshmana Rao and his associates founded the Vignana Chandrika Mandali.
Statement B: K.V. Lakshmana Rao and his associates founded the Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Vignana Chandrika Mandali and the Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam were founded by K.V. Lakshmana Rao and his associates.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Mir Osman Ali Khan founded Osmania University.
Reason (R): Osmania University was established in 1917.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but the year of establishment does not explain why Mir Osman Ali Khan founded Osmania University.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Nizam College
(b) Sri Venkateswara University
(c) Andhra University
(d) High Court of Andhra State

List-II
(i) Associated with Aghorenath Chattopadhyaya
(ii) Served higher education in Rayalaseema
(iii) Established in 1926; C.R. Reddy was the first Vice-Chancellor
(iv) Established on 5 July 1954

Choose the correct answer using the code given below.
mcqs.explanation: Nizam College was associated with Aghorenath Chattopadhyaya; Sri Venkateswara University served Rayalaseema; Andhra University was established in 1926 with C.R. Reddy as its first Vice-Chancellor; and the High Court of Andhra State was established on 5 July 1954.

mcqs.question: The Sri Bagh Pact was associated with which institution?
mcqs.explanation: The Sri Bagh Pact was associated with the High Court of Andhra State.

mcqs.question: The MIM was located in which place?
mcqs.explanation: The MIM was located in Hyderabad.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements are correct?
1. The Deccan Education Society promoted nationalist education.
2. The Deccan Education Society established Fergusson College in 1885.
3. CMS and Robert Turlington Noble founded Noble College/High School.
4. Noble College/High School provided early modern English education.
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct. The Deccan Education Society promoted nationalist education and established Fergusson College in 1885, while CMS and Robert Turlington Noble founded Noble College/High School, which provided early modern English education.

mcqs.question: Motupalli was known by which other name?
mcqs.explanation: Motupalli was also known as Desiyakondapattanam.

mcqs.explanation: The notes state that the Mandhata sculpture was discovered in Jaggayyapet.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I

(b) Nicolo Conti
(c) Nuniz
(d) Itsing

List-II

(ii) Visited Motupalli port

(iv) Italian traveller who visited South India
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Marco Polo–Motupalli port, Nicolo Conti–Italian traveller who visited South India, Nuniz–Achyutadeva Raya, and Itsing–Chinese traveller.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes Nuniz?
mcqs.explanation: Nuniz was an Italian traveller. The notes separately identify Itsing as Chinese and Tavernier as belonging to the 17th century.

mcqs.question: Itsing belonged to which era?
mcqs.explanation: Itsing belonged to the post-Satavahana era. The other periods are associated in the notes with Marco Polo, Nicolo Conti and Tavernier respectively.

mcqs.question: Who was contemporary of Sri Krishnadevaraya?
mcqs.explanation: Babur is identified as a contemporary of Sri Krishnadevaraya.

(b) Brahma Samaj (spread in Andhra)
(c) Dasa Samaj
(d) Fort St. George

List-II
(i) Kandukuri Veeresalingam
(ii) R. Venkataratnam
(iii) Brahma Naidu
(iv) English at Madrasapatnam
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: Brahmo Samaj (combined AP)—Kandukuri Veeresalingam; Brahma Samaj (spread in Andhra)—R. Venkataratnam; Dasa Samaj—Brahma Naidu; Fort St. George—English at Madrasapatnam.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): After the conquest of Udayagiri, Sri Krishnadevaraya took the idol of Balakrishnudu.
Reason (R): Udayagiri Fort was built by the English at Madrasapatnam.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: The assertion is true. The reason is false because the English built Fort St. George at Madrasapatnam; the notes do not attribute Udayagiri Fort to them.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Prola Raju-II built Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavalayam inside Warangal Fort.
Kesavalayam was built inside Warangal Fort by Prola Raju-II.
Sri Krishnadevaraya built Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavalayam inside Warangal Fort.
Swayambhu Devalayam was built inside Warangal Fort by Prola Raju-II.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is option 4. The builder was altered from Prola Raju-II to Sri Krishnadevaraya; Prola Raju-II built Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavalayam inside Warangal Fort.

mcqs.question: Annamayya was contemporary of whom?
mcqs.explanation: The contemporary association given for Annamayya is Saluva Narasimha Raya.

mcqs.question: Kharavela was contemporary of which of the following persons?
mcqs.explanation: The contemporary pairing given is Kharavela–Hala.

mcqs.question: Hastivarma of the Salankayana dynasty was contemporary of whom?
mcqs.explanation: The notes pair Hastivarma (Salankayana) with Samudragupta.

mcqs.question: Potana was contemporary of which ruler?
mcqs.explanation: Potana is paired with Pedakomati Vema Reddy as a contemporary.

mcqs.question: Which poet is identified as a contemporary of Potana?
mcqs.explanation: The notes identify Srinatha as a contemporary of Potana.

mcqs.question: Who founded the Brahmo Samaj in the combined Andhra Pradesh region?
mcqs.explanation: Kandukuri Veeresalingam is given as the founder of the Brahmo Samaj in combined Andhra Pradesh.

mcqs.question: Who was responsible for spreading the idea of the Brahma Samaj in Andhra?
mcqs.explanation: R. Venkataratnam was responsible for spreading the idea of the Brahma Samaj in Andhra.

mcqs.question: Who established the Dasa Samaj in Andhra?
mcqs.explanation: The Dasa Samaj was established in Andhra by Brahma Naidu.

mcqs.question: Who built the Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavalayam inside Warangal Fort?
mcqs.explanation: Prola Raju-II built the Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavalayam inside Warangal Fort.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Kandukuri Veeresalingam is associated with the Brahmo Samaj in combined Andhra Pradesh.
Reason (R): R. Venkataratnam was responsible for spreading the idea of the Brahma Samaj in Andhra.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but the role of R. Venkataratnam in spreading the Brahma Samaj does not explain Kandukuri Veeresalingam’s founding of the Brahmo Samaj.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Prola Raju-II built the Swayambhu Devalayam inside Warangal Fort.
Statement B: Prola Raju-II also built the Kesavalayam inside Warangal Fort.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both Swayambhu Devalayam and Kesavalayam inside Warangal Fort are attributed to Prola Raju-II.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Kharavela was contemporary of Hala.
II. Hastivarma was contemporary of Samudragupta.
III. Potana was contemporary of Pedakomati Vema Reddy.
mcqs.explanation: All three pairings are given: Kharavela–Hala, Hastivarma–Samudragupta and Potana–Pedakomati Vema Reddy.

mcqs.question:

List-I

(iv) Samudragupta
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Kharavela–Hala, Hastivarma–Samudragupta, Potana–Pedakomati Vema Reddy and Potana–Srinatha.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I

(c) Dasa Samaj

mcqs.question:
How many of the following pairings are correct?
1. Brahmo Samaj in combined AP — Kandukuri Veeresalingam

3. Dasa Samaj in Andhra — Brahma Naidu
